snp3.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme
snp3.10:1.3: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.10:1.4: pāpicchā bhante sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatāti.
snp3.10:2.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
snp3.10:3.3: kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko, atha kho pāpicchāva sāriputta moggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatāti,
snp3.10:3.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca: māhevaṃ kokālika māhevaṃ kokālika pasādehi kokālika sāriputta moggallānesu cittaṃ, pesalā sāriputta moggallānāti. tatiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko, atha kho pāpicchāva sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃgatāti. tatiyampi kho bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
snp3.10:4.1: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
snp3.10:4.2: acirapakkantassa ca kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattīhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭho ahosi.
snp3.10:4.3: sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ. muggamattiyo hutvā kaḷāyamattiyo ahesuṃ. kaḷāyamattiyo hutvā kolaṭṭhi mattiyo ahesuṃ. kolaṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kola mattiyo ahesuṃ. kola mattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ. āmalakamattiyo hutvā beluvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ beluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā billamattiyo ahesuṃ. billamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu, pubbañca lohitañca pagghariṃsu.
snp3.10:4.4: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu teneva ābādhena kālamakāsi,
snp3.10:4.5: kālakato ca kho kokāliko bhikkhu paduma nirayaṃ upapajji sāriputta moggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā.
snp3.10:5.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkanta vaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā sahampati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.10:5.3: kālakato ca bhante kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno sāriputta moggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvāti.
snp3.10:5.5: idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
snp3.10:6.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhu āmantesi:
snp3.10:6.2: idaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā …pe…
snp3.10:6.3: idamavoca bhikkhave brahmā sahampati, idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
snp3.10:7.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.10:7.2: kīvadighaṃ nu kho bhante padume niraye āyuppamāṇanti,
snp3.10:7.3: dīghaṃ kho bhikkhu padume niraye āyuppamāṇaṃ,
snp3.10:7.4: taṃ na sukaraṃ saṅkhātuṃ ettakāni vassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatāni iti vā ettakāni vassasahassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatasahassāni itivāti.
snp3.10:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati khāriko kosalako tilavāho tato puriso vassasatassa vassasahassassa accayena ekamekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya
snp3.10:8.2: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu vīsati khāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, natveva eko abbudo nirayo.
snp3.10:8.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati abbudā nirayā evameko nirabbudo nirayo,
snp3.10:8.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati nirabbudā nirayā evameko ababo nirayo,
snp3.10:8.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ababā nirayā evameko ahaho nirayo, seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ahahā nirayā evameko aṭaṭo nirayo,
snp3.10:8.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā evameko
snp3.10:8.8: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati kumudā nirayā evameko sogandhiko nirayo,
snp3.10:8.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati sogandhikā nirayā evameko uppalako nirayo,
snp3.10:8.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati uppalakā nirayā evameko puṇḍarīko nirayo,
snp3.10:8.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati puṇḍarīkā nirayā evameko padumo nirayo.
snp3.10:8.12: padumaṃ kho pana bhikkhu nirayaṃ kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvāti.
snp3.10:8.14: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
snp3.10:13.2: yo cāpi katvā na karomīti cāha,
snp3.10:18.2: iti ha taṃ labhate va suvāmi,
